title: TOP200 NAWA Programme
official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
program_type: Research employment programme attracting global research talent to Poland
duration: 2 to 4 years of full-time employment at a Polish university or research institute; the project implementation window is 2026 to 2032
description: TOP200 NAWA is an initiative of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange that attracts outstanding research talent from universities ranked in the global top 200 to Polish universities and research institutes, offering stable full-time employment for two to four years so that the researcher can build their own research team. title: Bekker NAWA Programme
degree: Doctoral and postdoctoral (PhD students, scientists and academic teachers)
official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
program_type: International research mobility fellowship for Polish-based researchers
duration: Research fellowships of 3 to 24 months; in the 2026 edition projects may start between 1 March and 1 October 2027
description: The Bekker NAWA Programme supports the international mobility of PhD students, scientists and academic teachers from Polish scientific and academic units by funding research fellowships of 3 to 24 months at recognised research centres abroad. It covers the scholarship holder's living expenses during the stay together with a mobility allowance, and the amount may be increased for a spouse, underage children, or an assistant with a severe or moderate disability. title: Walczak NAWA Programme
degree: Doctoral (PhD students and doctoral-school participants); also doctors and academic teachers
official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
program_type: Medical, pharmaceutical and health sciences research internship and professional development grant
duration: A stay of between one and six months in a foreign host centre, in one of three tracks: teaching, research or clinical
description: The Walczak NAWA Programme funds international mobility for researchers in medical, pharmaceutical and health sciences connected with Polish institutions, letting them carry out research and work alongside leading specialists in the best medical centres worldwide. Participants choose a teaching, research or clinical track for a stay of one to six months. Eligible applicants are PhD students and doctoral-school participants, doctors with at least a doctorate working in hospitals and other medical institutions, and academic teachers in the medical, pharmaceutical and health sciences. title: Visegrad Scholarship Program
duration: 1-2 semesters of full-time master's-level study or full-time post-master's (doctoral/postdoctoral) study or research
description: The Visegrad Scholarship Program funds 1-2 semesters of full-time master's-level study or full-time post-master's (doctoral/postdoctoral) study or research at more than 190 accredited higher-education institutions across Central and Eastern Europe. Visegrad country nationals apply to study in another Visegrad country; EaP/WB country nationals apply to study in a Visegrad country. The award is EUR 3,500 per semester for the scholar plus EUR 2,000 per semester to the host institution. Applications for the 2027/28 cycle open on 1 January 2027 and close on 15 April 2027 at 12:00 PM.

title: Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program
program_type: Non-degree professional development scholarship with internship
duration: Nine months (two semesters) of university classes plus at least two weeks of professional internship, introductory course and grantees' conventions; a parallel Kirkland Research track runs four months
description: The Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program is a nine-month non-degree professional development scholarship for graduates from Ukraine, Belarus, Russia, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan who already have at least two years of professional experience. Grantees attend two semesters of classes at one of about fifteen affiliated Polish universities, take part in an introductory course, trainings and grantees' conventions, and complete at least two weeks of professional internship. title: Poland My First Choice NAWA Programme
program_type: Government scholarship for international master's students
duration: The statutory period of full-time second-cycle (master's) studies at a Polish academic higher education institution
description: Poland My First Choice NAWA is a Polish government scholarship that funds the statutory period of full-time second-cycle (master's) studies at academic higher education institutions supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education. Beneficiaries receive the NAWA Director's scholarship of PLN 1,800 per month, an exemption from tuition fees at public universities and a one-time travel lump sum. title: UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships in Engineering
duration: 6 months of individual research, 1 October 2025 to 31 March 2026 in the 2025 edition
description: The UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships in Engineering place 28 six-month research fellowships at the UNESCO Chair for Science, Technology and Engineering at AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow at the disposal of UNESCO, for candidates from 57 invited developing Member States. The Polish authorities provide free tuition, a monthly allowance of PLN 1,800 or 2,200 and a one-time arrival allowance; UNESCO covers international travel, health insurance and a USD 120 pocket allowance.
